legal.name: Rosslyn Childrens Center Inc.
legal.governance: Parent Board of Directors — no private owners

hours.contactPageNote: Contact page lists 8:00am – 6:00pm — licensed hours take precedence on site

programs.name: Infant Program
programs.pedagogy: Teachers communicate intentions continuously, facilitate gentle social interactions, and let infants freely explore their environment.

programs.name: Toddler Program
programs.pedagogy: Children are acknowledged as capable decision-makers; teachers observe interests and build classroom experiences from those observations.

programs.name: Twos Program
programs.pedagogy: Teachers model respectful conversation to help classmates build positive interactions and growing independence.

programs.name: Preschool Program
programs.pedagogy: Children ask questions, discuss ideas, and learn through cooperative play with social-emotional development at the center.

tuition.schedule: Five days a week, year-round (holidays excluded)

dropIn.requirements: Non-expired physical and immunization record required

steps.title: Schedule a tour
steps.body: See a day in the life at RCC in person or virtually. A member of our team will answer questions about availability, tuition, and start dates.

steps.title: Submit an application
steps.body: After your tour, submit your child's application with a $100 fee payable to Rosslyn Children's Center.

steps.title: Parent meeting
steps.body: A 30-minute meeting with a school administrator to go deeper on curriculum, daily schedule, and your child's development.

steps.title: Admission & waitlist
steps.body: Admission depends on classroom availability. Families often spend time on a waitlist — we keep you informed on your position.

benefits: Health, dental, and vision at no cost

quotes.text: The teachers at RCC have taken amazing care of our family. My now-toddler has been there since an infant and they have consistently shown him individualized care and attention that has fostered his development in amazing ways.
Our son has been with RCC for almost 4 years and it has been such an incredible experience. The teachers and staff have poured into him and he has thrived.
I've been consistently impressed with the creativity and quality of the activities her teachers plan, and the complete love and joy they have for her.
RCC is warm, welcoming and the teachers are fantastic. We feel they truly care for our children as if they were their own.
The teachers are great at providing multiple photos and updates throughout the day and it's so appreciated for us working parents!

campusNotes: Main entrance just past the Kent Street entrance to Freedom Park
All classrooms visit Freedom Park each week
Older classes explore the farmers market, Gateway Park sandbox, and Rosslyn community events

beliefs: Each member of the community — children, families, and educators — feels valued in a physically, emotionally, and cognitively safe atmosphere.
Knowledge and creativity occur through interactions with people, the environment, and concepts.
Authentic learning happens when children collaborate, compare ideas, and inspire each other's thinking.
Children and adults develop a powerful sense of self when they explore new areas and find independent solutions.
Family–educator partnerships are sustained through conversations, newsletters, classroom visits, conferences, and events.
Each child's unique learning style is better understood when families and educators share perspectives and collaborate.
philosophy.curriculum: Emergent, play-based curriculum determined by what is relevant to the children — a new puppy, a sibling, a move. Each member must feel heard, supported, and challenged.

nondiscrimination: Rosslyn Children's Center will not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, gender, age, marital or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, political ideology or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. Rosslyn Children's Center acknowledges and protects the rights of children, families, and staff to their own culture, customs, beliefs, and practices.
